verses.ar: كَٱلثَّلْجِ فِي ٱلصَّيْفِ وَكَالْمَطَرِ فِي ٱلْحَصَادِ، هَكَذَا ٱلْكَرَامَةُ غَيْرُ لَائِقَةٍ بِٱلْجَاهِلِ.
verses.kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.web: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

verses.ar: كَٱلْعُصْفُورِ لِلْفَرَارِ وَكَالسُّنُونَةِ لِلطَّيَرَانِ، كَذَلِكَ لَعْنَةٌ بِلَا سَبَبٍ لَا تَأْتِي.
verses.kjv: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
verses.web: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

verses.ar: اَلسَّوْطُ لِلْفَرَسِ وَٱللِّجَامُ لِلْحِمَارِ، وَٱلْعَصَا لِظَهْرِ ٱلْجُهَّالِ.
verses.kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.
verses.web: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

verses.ar: لَا تُجَاوِبِ ٱلْجَاهِلَ حَسَبَ حَمَاقَتِهِ لِئَلَّا تَعْدِلَهُ أَنْتَ.
verses.kjv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.web: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

verses.ar: جَاوِبِ ٱلْجَاهِلَ حَسَبَ حَمَاقَتِهِ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ حَكِيمًا فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.web: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

verses.ar: يَقْطَعُ ٱلرِّجْلَيْنِ، يَشْرَبُ ظُلْمًا، مَنْ يُرْسِلُ كَلَامًا عَنْ يَدِ جَاهِلٍ.
verses.kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, [and] drinketh damage.
verses.web: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

verses.ar: سَاقَا ٱلْأَعْرَجِ مُتَدَلْدِلَتَانِ، وَكَذَا ٱلْمَثَلُ فِي فَمِ ٱلْجُهَّالِ.
verses.kjv: The legs of the lame are not equal: so [is] a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.web: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.ar: كَصُرَّةِ حِجَارَةٍ كَرِيمَةٍ فِي رُجْمَةٍ، هَكَذَا ٱلْمُعْطِي كَرَامَةً لِلْجَاهِلِ.
verses.kjv: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so [is] he that giveth honour to a fool.
verses.web: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

verses.ar: شَوْكٌ مُرْتَفِعٌ بِيَدِ سَكْرَانٍ، مِثْلُ ٱلْمَثَلِ فِي فَمِ ٱلْجُهَّالِ.
verses.kjv: [As] a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so [is] a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.web: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.ar: رَامٍ يَطْعَنُ ٱلْكُلَّ، هَكَذَا مَنْ يَسْتَأْجِرُ ٱلْجَاهِلَ أَوْ يَسْتَأْجِرُ ٱلْمُحْتَالِينَ.
verses.kjv: The great [God] that formed all [things] both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
verses.web: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

verses.ar: كَمَا يَعُودُ ٱلْكَلْبُ إِلَى قَيْئِهِ، هَكَذَا ٱلْجَاهِلُ يُعِيدُ حَمَاقَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: As a dog returneth to his vomit, [so] a fool returneth to his folly.
verses.web: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

verses.ar: أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا حَكِيمًا فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِهِ؟ ٱلرَّجَاءُ بِٱلْجَاهِلِ أَكْثَرُ مِنَ ٱلرَّجَاءِ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? [there is] more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.web: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْكَسْلَانُ: «ٱلْأَسَدُ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ، ٱلشِّبْلُ فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ!».
verses.kjv: The slothful [man] saith, [There is] a lion in the way; a lion [is] in the streets.
verses.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

verses.ar: اَلْبَابُ يَدُورُ عَلَى صَائِرِهِ، وَٱلْكَسْلَانُ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ.
verses.kjv: [As] the door turneth upon his hinges, so [doth] the slothful upon his bed.
verses.web: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

verses.ar: اَلْكَسْلَانُ يُخْفِي يَدَهُ فِي ٱلصَّحْفَةِ، وَيَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَرُدَّهَا إِلَى فَمِهِ.
verses.kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in [his] bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

verses.ar: اَلْكَسْلَانُ أَوْفَرُ حِكْمَةً فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِهِ مِنَ ٱلسَّبْعَةِ ٱلْمُجِيبِينَ بِعَقْلٍ.
verses.kjv: The sluggard [is] wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.web: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

verses.ar: كَمُمْسِكٍ أُذُنَيْ كَلْبٍ، هَكَذَا مَنْ يَعْبُرُ وَيَتَعَرَّضُ لِمُشَاجَرَةٍ لَا تَعْنِيهِ.
verses.kjv: He that passeth by, [and] meddleth with strife [belonging] not to him, [is like] one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.web: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

verses.ar: مِثْلُ ٱلْمَجْنُونِ ٱلَّذِي يَرْمِي نَارًا وَسِهَامًا وَمَوْتًا،
verses.kjv: As a mad [man] who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.web: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

verses.ar: هَكَذَا ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلْخَادِعُ قَرِيبَهُ وَيَقُولُ: «أَلَمْ أَلْعَبْ أَنَا!».
verses.kjv: So [is] the man [that] deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
verses.web: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

verses.ar: بِعَدَمِ ٱلْحَطَبِ تَنْطَفِئُ ٱلنَّارُ، وَحَيْثُ لَا نَمَّامَ يَهْدَأُ ٱلْخِصَامُ.
verses.kjv: Where no wood is, [there] the fire goeth out: so where [there is] no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
verses.web: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

verses.ar: فَحْمٌ لِلْجَمْرِ وَحَطَبٌ لِلنَّارِ، هَكَذَا ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلْمُخَاصِمُ لِتَهْيِيجِ ٱلنِّزَاعِ.
verses.kjv: [As] coals [are] to burning coals, and wood to fire; so [is] a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.web: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

verses.ar: كَلَامُ ٱلنَّمَّامِ مِثْلُ لُقَمٍ حُلْوَةٍ فَيَنْزِلُ إِلَى مَخَادِعِ ٱلْبَطْنِ.
verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer [are] as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.web: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

verses.ar: فِضَّةُ زَغَلٍ تُغَشِّي شَقْفَةً، هَكَذَا ٱلشَّفَتَانِ ٱلْمُتَوَقِّدَتَانِ وَٱلْقَلْبُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ.
verses.kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart [are like] a potsherd covered with silver dross.
verses.web: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

verses.ar: بِشَفَتَيْهِ يَتَنَكَّرُ ٱلْمُبْغِضُ، وَفِي جَوْفِهِ يَضَعُ غِشًّا.
verses.kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
verses.web: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

verses.ar: إِذَا حَسَّنَ صَوْتَهُ فَلَا تَأْتَمِنْهُ، لِأَنَّ فِي قَلْبِهِ سَبْعَ رَجَاسَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for [there are] seven abominations in his heart.
verses.web: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُغَطِّي بُغْضَةً بِمَكْرٍ، يَكْشِفُ خُبْثَهُ بَيْنَ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ.
verses.kjv: [Whose] hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the [whole] congregation.
verses.web: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَحْفِرُ حُفْرَةً يَسْقُطُ فِيهَا، وَمَنْ يُدَحْرِجُ حَجَرًا يَرْجِعُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
verses.web: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

verses.ar: اَللِّسَانُ ٱلْكَاذِبُ يُبْغِضُ مُنْسَحِقِيهِ، وَٱلْفَمُ ٱلْمَلِقُ يُعِدُّ خَرَابًا.
verses.kjv: A lying tongue hateth [those that are] afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.web: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
